visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy with short black hair wearing a black Stitch-themed t-shirt sits on a white bed. He holds a large, black, textured spherical toy that resembles a moon. An adult's hand is visible in the foreground holding a similar sphere. The room has soft lighting and a teal-colored sofa is visible in the background. (2) The boy enthusiastically pries open the black sphere, which splits into two halves. Inside, there is black shredded paper filler and a white opaque plastic bag. He looks down at the contents with a focused and curious expression. (3) The boy opens the white bag and extracts a small plastic capsule containing a Mickey Mouse figurine dressed as an astronaut. He holds the figure up to the camera, smiling slightly. The figurine is encased in a clear circular helmet. (4) The camera focus shifts to an adult's hand opening another black sphere on a black bubble-wrap surface. Inside, a second white bag is found. The adult pulls out a Stitch figurine, also in an astronaut suit with a clear helmet. (5) Both the Mickey and Stitch astronaut figures are placed side-by-side on the black bubble wrap. The boy's hands and the adult's hands are both visible, presenting the two collectibles to the viewer.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An adult female voice opens with a friendly, moderate-paced greeting over a light, bouncy acoustic guitar melody. (2) A sharp plastic rustling sound occurs as the blind box is opened, followed by a metallic 'ping' sound effect signaling a reveal. (3) The child's voice enters with a high-pitched, excited tone, identifying the Disney character. The BGM remains steady with a cheerful rhythm. (4) Another loud plastic rustling sound is heard as the second bag is manipulated, accompanied by a 'whoosh' transition effect. (5) A celebratory 'ta-da' style chime plays as the second figure is revealed. Both the child and the adult female exchange enthusiastic remarks about how 'cute' the toys are, their voices overlapping the constant background music.
